pre_training_prerequisites.pass_condition: Tier 0 train/validation/test manifests exist, include only selected labels, bind docs/model/dataset-source-register.json hash b02c73fce978b348166df54080541851612445ecd9d01e83bed0a9538620b8e8, and bind the SHA-256 of docs/model/return-to-form-fixed-crop-config.json.
Every selected manifest clip has relative_frame_tensor_path, frame_tensor_sha256, frame_tensor_provenance, and crop region metadata; check-files or equivalent audit exits 0.
A local or Brev-side dry run loads at least one batch per split with the expected class_count=5 and crop-region tensor shape.

stop_if: train_top1 remains below 0.5 after the planned smoke budget
training loss does not improve by at least 0.4 from initial to best
any selected label has zero train recall
training_sanity_gate.interpretation: Failure here means the fixed-crop/tensor/model path is not even fitting the small approved-source set; do not expand labels.

stop_if: validation_top1 is at or near random chance after train sanity passes
test metrics expose a split/source failure that invalidates the validation claim
validation_gate.interpretation: Passing validation is evidence for Tier 0 learnability only, not final product readiness.

allowed_inputs: existing reviewed negative-challenge manifests or a clearly marked small-proof reject set
stop_if: hard-negative false accept rate exceeds 0.2 at the selected threshold
threshold tuning accepts no true-class examples for any selected label
negative inputs are unreviewed or source/register status is unclear
hard_negative_gate.separation_from_final_gate: The full 17-type negative-challenge gate remains a final-promotion requirement and is still blocked by 12 underfilled final-promotion types.

no_zero_accepted_true_class_rule.pass_condition: For every selected label, at least one validation true-class clip is accepted above threshold and per-label accepted true-class count is reported.
no_zero_accepted_true_class_rule.stop_if: Any selected label has zero accepted true-class validation examples after thresholding.

non_goals: Do not export ONNX from this proof in M3AC.
Do not promote web/public/model/model-card.json from this proof in M3AC.
Do not claim final readiness from Tier 0 metrics.
Do not evaluate or promote the retained controlled clip-heldout checkpoint.
Do not weaken final-promotion negative-challenge requirements.
Do not expand to Tier 1 until Tier 0 passes these gates.
stop_rules: If M3AD cannot bind source/crop hashes or load tensors, fix M3AD before training.
If M3AE fails train sanity, inspect crop contact sheets, tensor provenance, and label selection before another run.
If M3AE passes train sanity but fails validation, record the split/source failure and do not scale labels.
If M3AE passes Tier 0 but hard-negative FAR fails, continue calibration/rejection work before any product claim.
If the next action requires new paid Brev spend, new source approval, final-gate policy changes, or human collection, stop for explicit user approval.
